verdict.rationale: Kling's developer docs version the API through /v1 endpoint paths and model_name parameters, and keep a dated changelog with dated discontinuation notices and a continuation commitment for the legacy API, so a version-and-deprecation practice exists. However, there is no standalone versioning or deprecation-policy document; the policy is implied by changelog entries and one continuation sentence. Missing for 10: a formal documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset process), an explicit API versioning scheme document, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The legacy API will continue to be available with no current plans for deprecation.
Notice: magic_match_tree will be discontinued on July 3rd, 2026
Add model_name parameter to distinguish model versions, default kling-v2-6
